descriptionChirho: Proper feminine noun חֲצֵרוֹת (Hazeroth), a wilderness encampment of Israel during the exodus, mentioned in Num 11:35; 12:16; 33:17–18; Deut 1:1. The name means 'enclosures' or 'courtyards' and designates a single geographic location. The two clusters differ only in prepositional framing: b-/m- Hazeroth ('in/from Hazeroth') versus w-Hazeroth ('and Hazeroth'). Multilingual renderings are uniform transliterations: eng 'Hazeroth', spa 'Hazerot/Jatserot', hin हसेरोत, arb حَضَيرُوت/حَصِيرُوت, kor 하세롯/하캘롯, swa 'Haseroti/Haserothi.'
